normalPerturbation.status: Confirmed static custom shader path; same bundle also contains different stock helper

normalPerturbation.stock: Normalizes both spatial derivatives before cross products. Equal bumpScale and height values alone do not preserve physical slopes.
normalPerturbation.originalAdaptation: With stock helper, divide deltaHeight X/Y by corresponding derivative lengths before perturbation; handle degenerate derivatives explicitly. Algebraically equivalent away from clamp.
